nodes.klein: to be crafty, be deceitful. he acted deceitfully (in the Bible occurring only in the part., see נוֹכֵל). he deceived, beguiled. he dealt deceitfully, dealt knavishly.

nodes.g: to cast, shoot, hurl to beguile, deceive, mislead, deal treacherously
Cozbi = "my lie" a daughter of Zur, a chief of the Midianites, who was slain by Phinehas…
